title_km: លីមីតអនុគមន៍ត្រីកោណមាត្រ

exercises.technique_km: គុណចែកកន្សោមដោយ x: (sin 2x / 2x) * (3x / sin 3x) * (2/3) -> 2/3
exercises.technique_en: Standard sinc limit ratio: (sin 2x / 2x) * (3x / sin 3x) * (2/3) -> 2/3

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = \pi - x -> 0, sin(5\pi - 5t) / sin(3\pi - 3t) = sin 5t / sin 3t -> 5/3
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = pi - x -> 0, yielding sin(5t)/sin(3t) -> 5/3

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = \pi - x -> 0, (\pi - t + \pi\cos(\pi - t)) / t = (\pi(1 - \cos t) - t) / t -> -1
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = pi - x -> 0, (pi(1 - cos t) - t)/t -> -1
Change of variable t = pi/2 - x -> 0, ((pi/2)(1 - cos t) - t)/t -> -1
Change of variable t = 2 - x -> 0, sin(pi(2-t))/(x(x-2)) -> -pi/2

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = x - \pi/3 -> 0, sin(3t + \pi) / (1 - 2\cos(t + \pi/3)) = -sin 3t / (\sqrt{3}\sin t - (1 - \cos t)) -> -\sqrt{3}
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = x - pi/3 -> 0, expanding trig terms gives -sqrt(3)
Change of variable t = pi/2 - x -> 0, standard half-angle limit (1 - cos t)/t^2 -> 1/2
Change of variable t = pi/2 - x -> 0 and half-angle factorization -> -1

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = x - \pi/2 -> 0, t * tan(t + \pi/2) = t * (-cot t) = -t / tan t -> -1
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = x - pi/2 -> 0, tan(t + pi/2) = -cot(t), t*(-cot t) -> -1

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = x - \pi/4 -> 0, cos(2t + \pi/2) / tan(2t + \pi/2) = (-sin 2t) / (-cot 2t) = sin^2(2t) / cos(2t)
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = x - pi/4
Change of variable t = 1 - x -> 0, (1 - cos(pi t))/t^2 -> pi^2 / 2
Change of variable t = 1 - x -> 0, (1 - cos(pi t / 2))/t^2 -> pi^2 / 8
Change of variable t = pi - x -> 0, (1 - cos(t/2))/t -> 0
Change of variable t = 1 - x -> 0, -tan(pi t)/(t(2-t)) -> -pi/2

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = \pi - x -> 0, t * tan(\pi/2 - t/2) = t * cot(t/2) = t / tan(t/2) -> 2
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = pi - x -> 0, t * cot(t/2) = t / tan(t/2) -> 2
Change of variable t = pi/2 - x -> 0, sin(t)/(2t * 2pi) -> 1/(4pi)
Transform numerator sqrt(2)sin(x - pi/4), dividing by -4(x - pi/4) -> -sqrt(2)/4

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = 1 - x -> 0, sin(\pi - \pi t) / (t(2 - t)) = sin(\pi t) / (t(2 - t)) -> \pi / 2
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = 1 - x -> 0, sin(pi t)/(t(2 - t)) -> pi/2
Change of variable t = x - 1 -> 0, -sin(pi t/2)/(t(t+2)) -> -pi/4

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{2}\sin x + 1): (2\sin^2 x - 1) / ((\tan x - 1)(\sqrt{2}\sin x + 1)) = -\cos 2x / ... -> 1/2
exercises.technique_en: Conjugate multiplication and trig identities -> 1/2

exercises.technique_km: បំប្លែងផលបូក 2\sin(x - \pi/3) / \sin 3x; តាង t = x - \pi/3 -> 0, 2\sin t / \sin(3t + \pi) = 2\sin t / (-sin 3t) -> -2/3
exercises.technique_en: Linear combo 2*sin(x - pi/3)/sin 3x, change of variable t = x - pi/3 gives -2/3
Factor denominator (x-1)(x+1), apply standard limit sin(x-1)/(x-1) -> 1/2
Change of variable t = pi/2 - x -> 0, (1 - cos 2t)/t^2 -> 2

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = \pi - x -> 0, \tan(\pi - t)\tan(\pi/2 - t/2) = (-\tan t)\cot(t/2) = -\tan t / \tan(t/2) -> -2
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = pi - x -> 0, -tan(t)/tan(t/2) -> -2
Change of variable t = x - 2 -> 0, sin(pi t)/(-t - t^2/4) -> -pi

exercises.technique_km: បំបែកមុំទ្វេ \cos 2x = (\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x); សម្រួលផលដក: -1 / (\cos x + \sin x) -> -1/\sqrt{2} = -\sqrt{2}/2
exercises.technique_en: Factor cos 2x = (cos x - sin x)(cos x + sin x), cancel factor -> -sqrt(2)/2
Change of variable t = x - pi/4 -> 0, denominator is -sqrt(2)sin t -> -sqrt(2)/2

exercises.technique_km: តាង t = x - \pi/3 -> 0, 2\sin t / (1 - 2\cos(t + \pi/3)) = 2\sin t / (\sqrt{3}\sin t - (1 - \cos t)) -> 2/\sqrt{3} = 2\sqrt{3}/3
exercises.technique_en: Change of variable t = x - pi/3 -> 0, 2sin t / (sqrt(3)sin t - 2sin^2(t/2)) -> 2*sqrt(3)/3
Change of variable t = 2 - x -> 0, t(4 - t)*cot(pi t/4) -> 16/pi

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (1 + \sqrt{2}\sin x) និងបំប្លែង 1 - \tan x = (\cos x - \sin x)/\cos x -> 2
exercises.technique_en: Conjugate multiplication and cos/sin conversion -> 2
Change of variable t = x - pi/3 -> 0, -3t / (-sin t + o(t)) -> 3

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ទាំងភាគយកនិងភាគបែង (1 + \sqrt{2}\cos x)(1 + \sqrt{2}\sin x): (1 - 2\cos^2 x)/(1 - 2\sin^2 x) = -\cos 2x / \cos 2x = -1
exercises.technique_en: Double conjugate multiplication: (1 - 2cos^2 x)/(1 - 2sin^2 x) = -cos 2x / cos 2x = -1

exercises.technique_km: បំបែកមុំទ្វេ \cos 2x = (\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x); សម្រួលកត្តា (\cos x - \sin x): \cos x + \sin x -> \sqrt{2}
exercises.technique_en: Factor cos 2x = (cos x - sin x)(cos x + sin x), cancel (cos x - sin x) -> sqrt(2)

exercises.technique_km: បំបែកត្រីធាភាគយក (2\sin x - 1)(\sin x - 1) និងភាគបែង (2\sin x - 1)(2\sin x + 1); សម្រួល (2\sin x - 1): (\sin x - 1)/(2\sin x + 1) -> -1/4
exercises.technique_en: Factor trinomials: (2sin x - 1)(sin x - 1)/[(2sin x - 1)(2sin x + 1)] -> -1/4

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{1 + \sin x}): (1 - \sin x) / ((1 - \sin^2 x)(\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{1 + \sin x})) = 1 / ((1 + \sin x)(\sqrt{2} + \sqrt{1 + \sin x})) -> \sqrt{2}/8
exercises.technique_en: Radical conjugate multiplication, cancel (1 - sin x) -> sqrt(2)/8
Transform denominator 1 - 2cos 2x = 4sin^2 x - 1 = (2sin x - 1)(2sin x + 1) -> 1/2
Transform denominator 2cos 2x + 1 = 4cos^2 x - 1 = (2cos x - 1)(2cos x + 1) -> 1/2

exercises.technique_km: គុណកន្សោមឆ្លាស់ (\sqrt{2\cos x} + 1): (4\cos^2 x - 1)(\sqrt{2\cos x} + 1) / (2\cos x - 1) = (2\cos x + 1)(\sqrt{2\cos x} + 1) -> 2 * 2 = 4
exercises.technique_en: Conjugate multiplication and factor 2cos 2x + 1 = (2cos x - 1)(2cos x + 1) -> 4

exercises.technique_km: ជំនួស \cos^2 x = 1 - \sin^2 x = (1 - \sin x)(1 + \sin x); សម្រួលកត្តា (1 - \sin x): 1 / (1 + \sin x) -> 1/2
exercises.technique_en: Replace cos^2 x = 1 - sin^2 x = (1 - sin x)(1 + sin x), cancel (1 - sin x) -> 1/2

exercises.technique_km: បំប្លែងភាគយក 2\sin x\cos x - (1 - 2\sin^2 x) - 1 = 2\sin x(\cos x + \sin x) - 2; ឬបំប្លែងផលបូក trig -> \sqrt{2}
exercises.technique_en: Trig identities in numerator: sin 2x - (1 + cos 2x) = 2sin x cos x - 2cos^2 x = 2cos x(sin x - cos x) -> sqrt(2)

exercises.technique_km: បំប្លែង 1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2(x/2); \sqrt{1 + \cos x} = \sqrt{2}|\cos(x/2)|; \sin x = 2\sin(x/2)\cos(x/2) -> \pm\sqrt{2}/2
exercises.technique_en: Half-angle identity sqrt(1 + cos x) = sqrt(2)|cos(x/2)|, sin x = 2sin(x/2)cos(x/2) -> +-sqrt(2)/2

exercises.technique_km: បំប្លែង 1 - \cos 2x = 2\sin^2 x; \sqrt{1 - \cos 2x} = \sqrt{2}|\sin x|; \sin 2x = 2\sin x\cos x -> \pm\sqrt{2}/2
exercises.technique_en: Half-angle identity sqrt(1 - cos 2x) = sqrt(2)|sin x|, sin 2x = 2sin x cos x -> +-sqrt(2)/2
